scope: research/pq-wkem only; normalized short-kernel compiler plus arbitrary public iid additive Z_q noise
proved_claims: Every Boolean assignment has an exact normalized-kernel pseudovector; each violated clause contributes one +2 and one -1 while Hx=0 and h=1.
For every probability distribution on Z_q, |phi(2t)| >= max(0,2|phi(t)|^2-1).
The complete iid-noise pseudovector character magnitude is |phi(t)|^L |phi(2t)|^v for odd key-sensitive t.
Honest half-shift TV delta implies some odd harmonic beta=|phi(t)|^L >= 2delta/q.
If L>=8 ln(1/beta) and v<=L/2, the public pseudovector character amplitude is at least beta^5; hence at least (2delta/q)^5 for the selected harmonic.
not_claimed: No generic impossibility for correlated or statement-dependent noise.
No break of LWE or SIS.
No completed generic PQ witness KEM.
Tests are not a security proof.
